block-guide:
CORE/NAVIGATION The site menu block. Two ways to fill it: - Inline links (what these tools write): navigation-link / navigation-submenu blocks inside it. The links belong to this block only; edit them where the block stands. - "ref": the id of a saved Navigation (wp_navigation post) edited in the Site Editor. These tools do not create or edit saved Navigations.
EMPTY BLOCK = FALLBACK, NOT YOUR MENU A navigation with neither ref nor links shows, in this order: the most recently published saved Navigation; else a classic menu (the "primary" location, a menu with the "primary" slug, else the newest one), converted and saved; else a list of all pages, also saved. Once any saved Navigation exists, classic menus are never consulted again: a menu made with create-menu does NOT appear in a theme header that uses an empty navigation block. To show chosen links, write them inline.
MARKUP (comments only, no HTML) <!-- wp:navigation {"overlayBackgroundColor":"base","overlayTextColor":"contrast","ariaLabel":"Main","layout":{"type":"flex","justifyContent":"right","flexWrap":"wrap"}} --> <!-- wp:navigation-link {"label":"About","type":"page","id":12,"url":"https://example.com/about/","kind":"post-type"} /--> <!-- wp:navigation-submenu {"label":"Guides","type":"custom","url":"#","kind":"custom"} --> <!-- wp:navigation-link {"label":"WordPress","url":"https://wordpress.org/","kind":"custom"} /--> <!-- /wp:navigation-submenu --> <!-- /wp:navigation --> A page or post link keeps "type", "id", "url" and "kind":"post-type" together (the editor follows the id when the page moves). An external link is "kind":"custom" with url only. Submenu: navigation-submenu with links inside; a parent without its own address uses url "#".
OPTIONS overlayMenu: "mobile" (default: a menu button on small screens), "always", "never" (footers). overlayBackgroundColor / overlayTextColor: palette slugs for the opened mobile menu. layout: {"type":"flex"} with justifyContent left|center|right|space-between; a vertical list is {"type":"flex","orientation":"vertical"}. ariaLabel names the landmark ("Main", "Footer").
CHECK Open the page on a narrow screen and press the menu button; reopen the editor to see the links.
